primary_metric: trace OFF fresh-container Docker E2E wall, same inputs/models/thresholds; startup/teardown included, observer teardown separate

cache_repetition.cold: new initially empty private Inductor/Triton directory for each pair; OS/driver cache not flushed
cache_repetition.warm: fresh container, same directory as its cold partner; no persistent model
cache_repetition.summary: all observations, paired deltas, median/range; historical single-observation results remain separate

parallel_component.treatment: same fresh image/container/env/memory cap; only disposable source concurrency differs
parallel_component.metric: component wall in same harness; no sampled-residency substitution

parallel_e2e.cache: same existing compiled shape inventory snapshot, per-condition private copy
parallel_e2e.treatment: same experimental scheduling shim both modes; SR batch completes/exits before sources; ordered consumption
quality: all pages ordered manifest identities and mapping geometry
original/x4 ordered source predictions and decoded staff/connector masks
combined and per-page base/final numbering pages+metadata including movement boundaries
MMR override targets/skips and geometry mapping

guards.numerical: strict semantic equality, no threshold/model/input retuning; preserve any failure
guards.resources: 16 GiB cgroup cap for both source concurrency conditions; device VRAM samples <=7 GiB to call resource screen passed
guards.gpu: discard known external competition; retain events/process queries and WSL attribution limitations
guards.adoption: investigation only, no production implementation or full68; remain Draft/unmerged

additional_priorities: interpreter import/cache permissions with CPU-only matching-class comparisons
compiled SR tile batch/stream timings if bounded screening remains warranted

python_imports.order: first A/default, first B/private-prefix, warm ABBA
python_imports.fixed: same image, UID, interpreter and YOLO class identity; no model/GPU inference
python_imports.metric: fresh child process wall and internal imports, initial prefix preparation separately
python_imports.gate: same imported class/version and CUDA not initialized; not an E2E adoption claim

omr_reuse.factor: 3 disposable per-page OMR processes versus 1 process accepting same three pages
omr_reuse.gates: all ordered source predictions identical, fixed selected model/default confidence/device; no integrated speed claim

compiled_tiles.input: two fixed interior 400-core/10-pad tiles from page_013 at x,y (400,400),(800,400)
compiled_tiles.fixed: production FP16/channels-last/reduce-overhead model and CPU uint8 readback
compiled_tiles.samples: one setup call plus 6 warm two-tile calls per fresh process/block
compiled_tiles.timing: host wall, enqueue/readback host, CUDA event intervals; first-call event may contain idle compile time, never count as GPU busy
compiled_tiles.advance: warm median >=1.05 speed ratio, reserved <=6 GiB, exact tested-core pixels; full-page/source/downstream remains unverified

numbering_semantic_replay.inputs: retained full 1/2-worker E2E outputs and their real MMR overrides
numbering_semantic_replay.action: actual production Phase C; no new detector/MMR inference
gates: first measure 1 after movement reset on second page
all replayed serial/parallel pages and metadata equal
numbering_semantic_replay.scope: additional fixed semantic validation, not a change to original E2E input/performance/accuracy contract

additional_validation_only.root_import_comparison: fresh identical containers UID 0 and 1000:1001, two identical default-prefix YOLO class imports each; CPU-only, source read-only; no model inference
additional_validation_only.timer_calibration: three fresh recorded CUDA event brackets around repeated fixed fp16 matrix multiplication; compare device interval with CPU perf_counter/monotonic_raw; no model outputs or E2E acceptance change
